$comment: Every Swift file and every function of the native module, with the one thing it asks MusicKit, ShazamKit or the player. Checked by scripts/check-native-bridge.mjs (CI, pre-commit). Adding an entry means adding native code, which needs a reinstall: put decisions in TypeScript (src/utils/musicKit.ts, AppleMusicProvider) instead. Budgets: raise one only with a reason in the PR.

files.ExpoMusicKitModule.swift: The module: one primitive per exposed function, plus the raw-value conversions.
files.LockedCache.swift: A thread-safe dictionary for the module's caches of MusicKit objects.

functions.requestAuthorization: Ask the user for Apple Music access.
functions.getAuthorizationStatus: Report the current Apple Music authorization status.
functions.loadLibraryPage: Read one page of library songs.
functions.loadPlaylistsPage: Read one page of library playlists with their track counts.
functions.loadPlaylistItems: Read every page of a playlist's entries.
functions.lookupLibrarySongs: Look ids up as library songs.
functions.lookupCatalogSongs: Look ids up in the Apple Music catalog (one request).
functions.aliasCachedItem: File a cached MusicKit object under a second id.
functions.cachedKinds: Report what is cached for each id.
functions.play: Play a cached item, optionally from a position.
functions.seek: Move the player to a position.
functions.getPlaybackState: Report the player's position and whether it is playing.
functions.findPlaylistsByName: Find every library playlist with an exact name, plus ones created here within a given time.
functions.addEachToPlaylist: Add cached items to a playlist one at a time, reporting each.
functions.removeFromPlaylist: Remove entries from a playlist this app created, reporting how many came out.
functions.addEachToLibrary: Add cached songs to the library one at a time, reporting each.
functions.previewInfo: Read a cached song's preview URL, ISRC, title, artist and duration.
functions.catalogPreviewForISRC: Look up a catalog song's preview URL by ISRC.
functions.shazamOffset: Find where a preview clip sits in its recording with ShazamKit.
functions.resolveArtworkURL: Get loadable artwork for a cached item, copying private-scheme artwork to a file.
